title: Missing-data timing and station rainfall trends in Nepal: code and derived data
description: Analysis code and derived data for the manuscript 'Missing-Data Timing Alters Station Rainfall Trend Estimates in Nepal' (Earth and Space Science). Code developed by Somnath Luitel. The repository contains the Python steps that produce every number, table and figure, annual precipitation indices, eligible-year flags, gap masks, station trends, paired treatment shifts and the results of the gauge and ERA5 masking experiments. Daily station records of the Department of Hydrology and Meteorology, Nepal, are not redistributed.
